text: {"final": {"summary": "P1: added can_pass(road_id, vehicle, network=None) to logistics/access.py, using road_status() and the status semantics (A: all vehicles, R: vans only, X: none). P2: added passable_route(warehouse_id, site, network=None) to logistics/routes.py — filters routes_between() to routes where a truck or a van can use every road, picks min by (km, id), returns (route, \"truck\") if a truck can use every road on it else (route, \"van\"), or None; best_route left unchanged. Also added rerouted_sites(network=None) -> list[str], which iterates all sites in name order (and their warehouses) and includes a site only when passable_route's route id differs from best_route's route id (vehicle-only changes don't count). P3: added notify_rerouted(sites, day) to notifications/sms.py — for each active household with sms_ok collecting at one of the given sites, queues exactly one DELIVERY_MOVED text filled with the household's site and the new day, and returns the messages sent.", "done_steps": ["P1", "P2", "P3"]}}
